protocol.vision: unchanged native BF16, no CLS, two serial cameras, original CPU pixel division
protocol.model: load_vlm_weights=True; all parameters frozen, unchanged versions
protocol.method: unchanged edbac60 source gate G at raw layer12; same scalar decision for both views; raw reuse or layer3 alpha=.75 second vision pass
protocol.execution: native actor.act once; connector once per camera; native VLM prefix once and Flow10 once; no detector RNG draw or queue advance
protocol.calibration: unchanged init0 target-task LOTO; gate copied from edbac60 nested9/8/7 source-only fit
protocol.environment: native Vanilla base with existing audited official Plus scene selectors; EGL env.noise=0
protocol.sensor: same 20 bilateral severity3 cases, independent view seeds, t0 through entire episode
protocol.pairing: same initial physical/render state and RGB; identical CPU/CUDA RNG prefixes; pair-local raw RGB canonicalization only when full physical AND render state match, <=64 pixels/view and <=1 uint8 LSB; otherwise abort
protocol.scope: one-policy-seed exploratory development pilot, not independent confirmation or a SALT reproduction

latency.scope: end-to-end native actor.act including CPU preprocessing, device transfer, actual gate/stats, connectors, one VLM prefix and Flow10; synchronized CUDA; episode reset/seeding/adapter construction excluded
latency.representative_selection: first manifest case per category, before current outcomes; actual gate decision, never forced
latency.instrumentation: no call-count mocks or full cache-pixel checks during timing; same actual evaluation adapter

limitations: one policy seed, fifty previously accessed development conditions, not untouched confirmation
nominal McNemar is not task-dependence or multiplicity adjusted; task bootstrap has only ten clusters
source gate is pointwise95, not trajectory-wise95; t0 zero activation does not guarantee zero later Clean activation
no concurrent unconditional V1 arm; old V1 results are descriptive historical context, not a new paired three-arm comparison
no result establishes pretraining causality, universal geometry preservation, or CoRP deep-gate performance
extra task0/init1 pair excluded from fifty-condition main table; all harms and paired discordances retained

postchecks.historical_note: Cross-run renderer/numerical trajectory sensitivity retained; the current concurrent paired baseline is authoritative. Old excluded attempt and old V1 are not mixed into current statistical comparisons.

renderer_recovery_review.observed_failure: strict same-SimState RGB equality at t01_clean_i2 under four-worker evaluation
renderer_recovery_review.raw_discrepancy_magnitude: not retained in aborted worker; do not assert measured LSB/pixel magnitude
renderer_recovery_review.recovery: fresh full run; include explicit geometry/camera/light transforms in state key; pair-local raw-image equality guard reuses pre-existing CoRP <=64 pixels/view <=1 LSB bound, logs every event and aborts beyond bounds; method, source threshold and alpha unchanged
